Quite possibly the best Astartes simulator ever made.

You play as Captain Titus of the ultramarines. (lets just ignore the fact that according to lore the captain is someone completely different)

You arrive on a planet overrun by xenos. You dont know exactly why they are here and frankly you dont give a damn. You spend most of the game stomping the living god out of the orks of various types mostly the same handful of types.

Using a combination of assorted firearms, melee weapons and your own fists you proceed to spread the will of the emperor to those unenlightened.

The gameplay is overall entertaining if not adventureous. You'll find yourself trying to make things more entertaining by mixing up ranged and melee combat at later parts in the game. Enemy variety is sparse for the most part, which can get tiring rather quickly.
Combos looks mean and nasty particularly the finishers you can perform.

The game simulates running around as one of the emperor's finiest quite well. you feel impressive and overwhelmingly powerful most times. Though the game can at times quickly show you just how mortal you are at a moment's notice.

Multiplayer is a mixed bag. the community seems to be on perpetual life support and good luck finding a match in any of the more odd game modes, deathmatch seems to be the only mode worth getting into as well as the online coop mode. my advice? skip the DLC they are a literal waste of money.

in summary a fun game to honor the emperor with. get it when it's on sale.
Even if 3PS's arent your main thing, if you like the 40k universe and think Space Marines are freaking cool, check it out, solid game, solid gameplay, also MO' 'UMANS TO KILL!

At its core, this Warkhammer 40K: Space Marine is a sparse 3rd Person Shooter/Melee. You will learn everything it has to offer and fight almost every enemy type within the first fifteen minutes of playing. There is no depth beyond that, however I found the violence to be enjoyable all the way to the end. This is probably because of my previous affnity for anything Warhammer 40K related. This game is the best up close look of at this universe. The graphics do it justice, not just technically. The gothic visuals and bolting audio puts the grititiness of 40K in violent display.

If you'e not a 40K superfan, than maybe this game will be too shallow when compare to more lauded action games. If you are, it's nice to finally see 40K violence up close.
